correctness.rationale: Equation \(1\) follows from conditioning on a marked \(r\)-hit box; strict negativity for every even \(r\) follows from \(v=[1+(m-1)u]/m\) and Jensen. The odd-frequency first differences are \(2(u^{n-r}-v^n)\), whose signs change at most once, while the sequence tends to one and begins negative when odd \(r\ge3\). The fixed-frequency large-dimension limit has root \(e^{2c}+2c=2r-1\). These arguments cover all declared integer parameters. Exact enumeration and rational tests verify 25,210 bounded parameter cases but are not used as infinite proofs.

value.rationale: \(H\) is the exact Hamming distance in an \(m\)-dimensional coordinate-flip walk, while \(F_r\) describes its coordinate-use spectrum. The theorem answers a natural signed dependence question in every finite uniform occupancy model, separates even frequencies from odd ones, proves one and only one sign transition for odd \(r\ge3\), and determines the precise linear-in-\(m\) transition constant. This is a structural boundary, not just a numerical case or recomputation of known moment tables.
